<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-05-2103-30-33" status="unreviewed">des na <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3810">gangs pa</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4206">stag pa</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs> na re <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign>'i mtshan nyid tshul gsum nges pa yin te <rs type="work">gzhung</rs> nas kyang <quote><!--from pvin-->
         <lg>
            <l xml:space="preserve">[]rjes dpag bya dang de mtshungs la||</l>
            <l xml:space="preserve">[ ]yod dang med la med par ni||</l>
            <l xml:space="preserve">[]nges pa ste </l>
         </lg>
      </quote> zhes pa dang |
      <rs type="work">de'i 'grel pa</rs> nas <quote>
         <lg>
            <l xml:space="preserve">tha mar spros pa nges pa ni gnyis ka la blta bar bya'o </l>
         </lg>
      </quote> zhes bshad pa dang |
      yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780">slob dpon [(p.241)]chos mchog</rs> gis <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign> ni sgron ma tsam gyis rung ba ma yin te des na nges pa la ltos so zhes bshad pas zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
